boundaries: All NPCs, conversations, sponsor offers and companies in the adventure are fictional.
Use observed indoor runs and available lots for personal crop stories. Empty, failed, borrowed and unknown context never grants a personal harvest or flower story.
Culture is read by a compact STABLE service-only RPC, returned transiently to the UI, and removed from persisted snapshots. The subject used by a published post stays in its receipt.
Choices keep existing IDs, intents, tags, effects, costs and branch modifiers. New prose and specific replies are applied at presentation time.
Narrative version 3 separates the producer stories from the frozen V2 catalogue and older versions. Past publications and gains remain intact; incompatible old branch memory is cleared once.
Illustrations stay static local WebPs; neither originals nor image payloads are stored in Supabase.
